name: Be Like Bill
look: A simple drawing on a white square with a thick black border. A smiling stick figure wearing a grayish-brown knit beanie with a dark red pom-pom stands on the right side, leaving the left side empty for text.
use: Bill models sensible behavior. The text follows the pattern 'This is Bill. Bill does something reasonable. Bill is smart. Be like Bill,' usually as a polite dig at people who do the opposite.
slots: left side: 'This is Bill' and the sensible thing Bill does
closing line: 'Bill is smart. Be like Bill.'
examples: This is Bill. Bill finished the show and didn't post spoilers.
Bill is smart. Be like Bill.
This is Bill. Bill puts his shopping cart back.
Bill is considerate. Be like Bill.
describe: stick figure with a beanie and a smiley face
stick man in a winter hat on a white background
smiling stickman wearing a knit cap with a pom pom
stick figure meme telling people to do the sensible thing
drawing of a guy in a bobble hat giving passive aggressive advice
origin: A stick-figure format that spread widely on Facebook, with captions praising Bill's sensible habits.
